description: Fetches the full SMI record for a typed reference ("<type>:<id>") that search returned. Pass only an id that appeared in a search result; do not construct one. If you already have a plain SMI record id, use smi_get_deep_report or smi_get_export to read it, or smi_check_order_complete for its readiness.

id.description: A typed reference returned by search, e.g. "deep_report:123"
